limitations: The article establishes an invited audience position, not actual reader assent or reception.

scope_outcomes.criterion: Consequential contrasts or acts of identification make one position salient while reducing the availability of an alternative.
scope_outcomes.basis: The article contrasts transformative and reparative critical theory, impersonal structures and recognition relations, and decolonial liberation and colonial recognition; findings F2, F4, F8, F9 capture these contrasts.
limitations: The force of the framing partly depends on accepting transformative anticapitalism as critical theory’s governing standard.
scope_outcomes.review_basis: All cited findings are confirmed; the contrasts are anchored in the text.

scope_outcomes.criterion: Linked persuasive moves support a text-specific reading, while a counter-passage supplies a consequential complication.

limitations: The conclusion’s necessity depends on contestable premises about theoretical identity and critical theory’s proper mission.
